reviews.title: My $180 Subscription Turned Into $540
reviews.text:
★☆☆☆☆

I was a loyal SignNow customer for years, paying approximately $180 annually for what I reasonably understood to be an e-signature service that allowed me to send documents as needed.

The company has now moved to a dramatically different pricing model. What used to be effectively unlimited document-signing usage is now limited to 100 signing invites per year, with additional usage charged separately. In my case, I was charged an extra $360 on top of my annual subscription before my subscription year had even ended.

What is most frustrating is that the pricing pages prominently advertise features such as “Send documents for eSignature,” “Unlimited users,” and “Send in bulk,” while the usage limitations and overage charges are far less obvious.

After escalating the matter, SignNow ultimately agreed to refund the overage charges and cancel my subscription. I appreciate that resolution, but I cannot recommend a service that changed its pricing structure so drastically and made it so easy for longtime customers to incur hundreds of dollars in unexpected charges.

Existing customers should carefully review their account usage and billing statements.

reviews.title: Going down hill as time goes on
reviews.text:
Been using for almost three years now.  Loved it in the beginning.  But like everything this else, people have to “improve” things and it’s far from an improvement.  In the last update when you touch the screen now to do anything it jumps around. Always have to go back and do it a second time. 

If you want to improve it here are a few suggestions.  
1) Have an option for bulk scanning to make things quicker and easier.
2) Have an option to select several documents for bulk deletion. 
3) Reduce the amount of pop ups asking me if I’m sure I want to do something or at least let me select what I am ok with it asking.  I don’t need to be reminded multiple times that I’m not on WiFi or cell service will be used. Takes a lot of time and really annoys me.
 
The majority of the items I use this app for require me to scan in multiple pages. Because of the numerous questions asked and options I have to select to do this it’s time consuming so I’ve been using a FREE app to do those.  I pay for this one and am surprised that’s still not an option after asking for it the last three years.  I guess I can always see what else is out there.
